selection.identity_join: exact peptide/ChEMBL identifier or full InChIKey; names are never used
selection.coordinates: one observation is peptide x tissue x species x source experiment
selection.unit_policy: Kp is dimensionless; original source units are retained and incompatible units are flagged
selection.origin_policy: model-derived and computed values are never is_measured=true; experimental ratios are computed_from_experimental_measurements
selection.training_policy: quality-eligible rows also require an explicit confirmed/reviewed curation status
selection.normalization_policy: no value imputation and no inverse-ratio conversion

notes: Rows are source observations and remain pending human confirmation.
Brain/plasma AUC ratios remain distinguishable through ratio_basis=AUC.
Computed/model-derived values are not counted as measured.
